faq.title: Before you request a demo.
faq.subtitle: The questions nursing home directors, home care leads, and hospital teams ask us most often.

q0.question: What does onboarding look like?
q0.answer: We support the migration of existing records and train the teams on site. The precise timeline is defined after auditing the institution during the demo.

q1.question: How do you integrate with our existing system?
q1.answer: Documented REST API. Synchronization possible via webhooks and CSV/JSON exports. Native HL7/FHIR integration for hospitals is in development and will ship in a future release.

q2.question: What if we decide to leave?
q2.answer: Your data is yours. Full export on demand, no fees, in open formats (CSV, JSON). Precise exit terms are defined in the contract.

q3.question: How does pricing work?
q3.answer: Personalized quote issued after a 30-minute demo, based on the size of the institution, the modules chosen, and the number of users.

q4.question: Does our data stay in Switzerland?
q4.answer: Yes. Infrastructure hosted in Switzerland (Infomaniak, Geneva). No patient data leaves Swiss territory. Cantonal adaptations discussed case by case.

q5.question: How do I request a demo?
q5.answer: Request a 30-minute demo via the contact form or by email. We then issue a personalized quote once we've understood your needs.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How CareBond collects, uses and protects your personal data under the nLPD.
privacy.intro: CareBond SA handles your personal data carefully, in compliance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nLPD) and international best practices. This policy describes what we collect on this marketing site, why, and what rights you have.

controller.heading: 1. Data controller
controller.body: The controller of personal data collected via carebond.ch is CareBond SA, based in Geneva, Switzerland. For any question about your data, write to us at contact@carebond.ch.

data.heading: 2. Data collected
data.body: We collect only the data you voluntarily provide via the contact form: full name, professional email address, name of your institution, type of facility (nursing home, home care, hospital, clinic, other) and the content of your message. We do not collect advertising identifiers, nor browser fingerprints. The site contains no third-party tracking cookies.

purposes.heading: 3. Purposes
purposes.body: Your data is used exclusively to respond to your demo or information request, schedule a conversation, and where appropriate prepare a personalized quote. We do not use it for automated marketing or profiling.

legalBasis.heading: 4. Legal basis
legalBasis.body: Processing of your data is based on your explicit consent (voluntary form submission) and on our legitimate interest in responding to your business inquiry, in accordance with the nLPD.

recipients.heading: 5. Recipients and processors
recipients.body: Your data is accessible only to CareBond SA's internal team. We use two technical processors: (a) Vercel Inc. for site hosting (fra1 region, Frankfurt, EU); (b) Resend Inc. for delivering contact form emails. No other third party receives your data.

transfers.heading: 6. International transfers
transfers.body: Vercel Inc. and Resend Inc. are US-based companies. Data passes through their infrastructure as part of the technical operation of the site and form. These transfers are governed by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and each provider's compliance commitments. Vercel's primary hosting region for this site is in the European Union (Frankfurt).

retention.heading: 7. Retention
retention.body: Messages received via the contact form are kept in our mailbox for as long as needed to process your request, then archived or deleted according to our internal document management practices. You may request deletion of your data at any time.

rights.heading: 8. Your rights
rights.body: Under the nLPD, you have rights of access, rectification, deletion, portability, objection, and restriction of processing of your data. To exercise these rights, write to us at contact@carebond.ch describing the nature of your request. You may also lodge a complaint with the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).

security.heading: 9. Security
security.body: The site uses TLS 1.3 to encrypt exchanges between your browser and our servers. Form data travels end-to-end encrypted between your device, the Vercel infrastructure, and the final inbox.

cookies.heading: 10. Cookies and trackers
cookies.body: This site currently uses no audience measurement or marketing cookies. Only strictly necessary cookies (for example, language preference) may be set. See our cookie policy for details.

changes.heading: 11. Changes
changes.body: This policy may be updated to reflect technical, legal, or organizational changes. The last-updated date is shown at the top of this page.

problem.heading: A typical nursing home loses too much caregiver time to paperwork.
problem.intro: Every hour spent filling a binder is an hour not spent with residents. CareBond gives those hours back to care.

points.p0: The day's rounds live on a piece of paper that gets misplaced, and handover to the next shift happens via phone call.
points.p1: Families call three times a week for updates — and nobody really has the time to respond properly.
points.p2: Cantonal audits require weeks of preparation to gather the right files in the right format.
points.p3: Non-French-speaking residents and their families face a constant language barrier with the care team.

features.heading: A platform built for the reality of a nursing home.
features.intro: Not a generic ERP retrofitted for healthcare. Designed from line one for Swiss constraints: nLPD, KVG/LAMal, cantonal requirements.

f0.title: Multi-facility oversight
f0.description: Multiple homes from a single console. Comparable KPIs, strict data separation, granular RBAC per team and site.

f1.title: Native nLPD audit log
f1.description: Every access and modification logged immutably. Documentation ready for internal audits and cantonal authorities.

f2.title: Multilingual chat
f2.description: The Spanish-speaking resident chats with the French-speaking caregiver, each reading in their own language. Barrier gone, communication stays.

f3.title: Multi-team & shared reports
f3.description: Management, caregivers, housekeeping, external providers — each with their access level and interface, with granular permissions. Reports, consultations and vitals recorded by one caregiver are instantly visible to every professional assigned to the same resident — no more information gaps between shifts. A filtered mini-report is sent in parallel to the family.

features.roadmap: BESA, RAI and PLAISIR integrations under study for a future release.

cta.title: See CareBond with your nursing home in mind.
cta.description: A 30-minute demo on your real cases: size, cantons, modules chosen, a typical resident's journey at your facility.

home-care.title: Trust at a distance, without intrusive surveillance.
home-care.subtitle: GPS visit validation, cryptographically signed reports, opt-in livestream from the patient. Built for Spitex CH and equivalent services.
home-care.metaDescription: CareBond solution for Spitex and home care: GPS geofencing, HMAC reports compliant with KVG/LAMal, opt-in livestream, family mini-reports.
home-care.visualAlt: Preview of the family app — daily mini-report and livestream feed activated by the patient

problem.heading: Home care is trust — and it's built or broken with every visit.
problem.intro: At a distance, families have no proof the visit happened, caregivers can't communicate everything in a text, and management has no time to verify everything by hand.

points.p0: Families call to find out if the morning visit went well — over and over.
points.p1: The caregiver writes a paper report that ends up in a pile at month-end.
points.p2: Critical alerts get lost between WhatsApp, texts and missed calls.
points.p3: Confirming presence at the patient's home means photos or calls — time-consuming and unreliable.

features.heading: The field validated, without disturbing anyone.
features.intro: The tools Spitex teams need to do their job without wasting time proving they did it.

f0.title: GPS visit validation
f0.description: Automatic geofencing at the patient's home. Presence is confirmed without action, and the family receives the notification.

f1.title: HMAC-signed reports, shared across the team
f1.description: Every visit report is cryptographically signed and instantly visible to every caregiver assigned to the same patient — morning shift, evening shift, lead nurse. Compliant with KVG/LAMal requirements for billing and audit. A filtered mini-report is sent in parallel to the family.

f2.title: Opt-in livestream, with AI-powered fall detection
f2.description: The patient's camera can be enabled or disabled by the patient or caregiver at any time. Real-time AI fall detection, never recorded — live stream only. Full access log.

f3.title: Prioritized alerts
f3.description: Urgent first, the rest queues up. No more critical alert lost in a message thread.

cta.title: See CareBond with your home care service.
cta.description: 30 minutes to understand the reality of your operation and calibrate the demo on the modules that matter to you.

hospitals.title: A platform designed to integrate with your EMR.
hospitals.subtitle: Documented REST API available today, HL7/FHIR integration in development. Department-level RBAC, immutable audit log, 3D plans and indoor GPS.
hospitals.metaDescription: CareBond solution for hospitals: documented REST API, HL7/FHIR integration in development, multi-department RBAC, 3D plans + indoor wayfinding.
hospitals.visualAlt: 3D isometric plan of a hospital — operating theaters, MRI suite, ward, laboratory, main lobby, with indoor GPS route

problem.heading: In a hospital, time lost finding your way or re-keying data is care lost.
problem.intro: Visitors get lost in corridors. Systems don't talk to each other. Cross-cutting nLPD audits take weeks. And each department has its own tools.

points.p0: Visitors and outpatients wander the corridors, and any reception desk ends up doubling as an info desk.
points.p1: Your current EMR doesn't talk to your scheduling tool, your reports, or your cross-departmental patient record.
points.p2: An nLPD audit means clicking through five different systems to assemble one file.
points.p3: Each service (ER, medicine, radiology) manages its own permissions — no consistency, no unified RBAC.

features.heading: A platform built to integrate, not to replace.
features.intro: CareBond doesn't aim to replace your EMR. We plug in, close the gaps, and add what was missing: indoor wayfinding, multilingual communication, cross-departmental audit.

f0.title: Documented REST API, HL7/FHIR in development
f0.description: Sync with your existing EMR via REST API and webhooks today. Native HL7/FHIR integration is in development and will ship in a future release.

f1.title: Multi-department & RBAC
f1.description: ER, medicine, radiology: watertight separation, granular permissions per role and department. Without re-coding your ACL.

f2.title: Immutable audit log
f2.description: Every action logged, exportable. Trail compliant with nLPD and cantonal hospital audit requirements.

f3.title: 3D plans & indoor GPS
f3.description: Isometric modeling of your building + built-in GPS guiding visitors, families and clinicians to the right service.

cta.title: See CareBond with your hospital constraints.
cta.description: 30 minutes to discuss EMR integration, cantonal requirements, and modules relevant to your services.

clinics.title: Premium patient experience, in your brand.
clinics.subtitle: Multilingual chat for international patients, white-label, Swiss hosting. Built for clinics that want the rigor of a professional platform without losing their identity.
clinics.metaDescription: CareBond solution for private clinics: multilingual chat, white-label, exclusive Swiss hosting, nLPD compliance.
clinics.visualAlt: Multilingual chat preview — FR↔ES messages translated in real time with caregiver control

problem.heading: A private clinic is neither a hospital nor a nursing home — its constraints are unique.
problem.intro: International patients, strong clinic brand, telemedicine between physical consultations, expectation of premium experience at every touchpoint.

points.p0: Your patients come from everywhere — Spain, Italy, Germany, outside the EU. The language barrier is a daily reality.
points.p1: Your clinic brand is an asset. You don't want a third-party platform diluting it with its own branding.
points.p2: Telemedicine between two physical appointments is expected, not optional.
points.p3: Your VIP patients demand a level of confidentiality that a consumer-grade tool can't guarantee.

features.heading: A professional platform, in your image.
features.intro: CareBond's technical foundation, your branded interface and experience. With all the multilingual + nLPD capabilities from day one.

f0.title: Multilingual chat, controlled by the caregiver
f0.description: Each message in each person's language. The caregiver enables or disables the chat depending on the clinical context.

f1.title: White-label
f1.description: Your brand, your colors, your domain. Our technical foundation, invisible. Your patients see your clinic, not our logo.

f2.title: Premium confidentiality
f2.description: Immutable audit log, TLS 1.3 encryption, exclusive Swiss hosting. No data leaves the country.

f3.title: International patients
f3.description: Primary hosting in Switzerland, optimized access for patients who travel or live abroad.

cta.title: See CareBond with your clinic in mind.
cta.description: 30 minutes to explore how to keep your brand and patient experience while gaining the multilingual + nLPD capabilities.

about.title: Swiss healthcare, better equipped.
about.subtitle: CareBond is a Swiss platform built for nursing homes, home care, hospitals and clinics. We build the tool missing between patients, families, caregivers and management — without trying to replace what already works.
about.metaDescription: About CareBond — Swiss platform for nursing homes, Spitex, hospitals and clinics. Mission, values, and where we're based.

mission.heading: Give care back the time paperwork takes from it.
mission.body1: In a Swiss nursing home, caregivers spend on average too many hours filling binders, handing over by phone, and gathering documents for audits. Those hours don't go to the resident.
mission.body2: CareBond returns them to care. By centralizing digital rounds, nLPD audit, multilingual chat, cryptographically signed reports, and indoor navigation in a single platform.
mission.body3: We don't replace your existing EMR. We plug into it, close the gaps, and add what was missing — with no rip-and-replace.

values.heading: What we refuse and what we stand for.
values.intro: Four architectural choices we've held since the first line of code. They define what CareBond does as much as what CareBond will never do.

v0.title: Privacy-first, not privacy-as-an-option
v0.description: No tracking cookies. No ad pixels. No leakage to Google Analytics. The nLPD is in the architecture, not in an addendum.

v1.title: The caregiver stays in control
v1.description: Chat, livestream, prescriptions — the professional decides when and how. CareBond never bypasses the clinician.

v2.title: Audit log by default
v2.description: Every access and modification is logged. Not as an option, not after configuration: from day one, on every action.

v3.title: Swiss, no detour
v3.description: Swiss hosting (Infomaniak, Geneva). No foreign cloud, no transfer to the hyperscalers, no extraterritorial jurisdiction.

location.body: CareBond SA is based in Geneva, Switzerland. We work in French, German, Italian and English — because that's Swiss reality.

cta.title: See if CareBond makes sense for you.
cta.description: 30 minutes to understand your context and show you the platform with your real use cases. No generic demo.

compliancePage.title: Compliance by architecture, not by addendum.
compliancePage.subtitle: Native nLPD, KVG/LAMal, exclusive Swiss hosting, immutable audit log. Compliance isn't a layer we added — it's built into the platform from line one.
compliancePage.metaDescription: CareBond compliance: nLPD, KVG/LAMal, Swiss hosting, audit log, cantonal hospital requirements.

nlpd.title: Native nLPD
nlpd.description: Native audit log of accesses and modifications, built for Swiss law from the first line of code. Not a recycled GDPR patch.

hosting.title: Swiss hosting
hosting.description: Infrastructure hosted at Infomaniak (Geneva). Patient data does not leave Swiss territory — no exception, no hidden clause.

encryption.title: Modern encryption
encryption.description: TLS 1.3 in transit on Swiss servers, encryption of backups at rest, HMAC-signed visit reports.

audit.title: Immutable audit log
audit.description: Immutable trace of every access and modification, exportable for your internal audits and cantonal authorities. Granular RBAC and multi-institution.

regulations.heading: Built for Swiss law.
regulations.intro: CareBond was built for specific Swiss requirements, not adapted from a European product. Here are the main frameworks we address.

nlpd.title: nLPD (Federal Act)
nlpd.description: Federal Act on Data Protection. Native audit log, rights of access and rectification, complaint route to the FDPIC documented in our privacy policy.

kvg.title: KVG / LAMal
kvg.description: Visit reports cryptographically signed (HMAC), traceability compliant with health-insurance requirements for Spitex and hospital billing.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.description: The few transfers outside Switzerland (contact form via Resend, hosting via Vercel fra1 Frankfurt) are governed by Standard Contractual Clauses and documented.

certifications.heading: Targeted certifications
certifications.intro: Beyond the nLPD requirements and data sovereignty already covered by our architecture, CareBond is working toward internationally recognized certifications expected by hospital procurement teams.

iso27001.title: ISO/IEC 27001
iso27001.description: Information security management system. Certification process in preparation for 2026-2027.

hds.title: HDS — French Health Data Host
hds.description: French reference certification for hosting health data. Under evaluation for our offering to Swiss institutions that require an HDS-equivalent qualification.

docs.title: Your legal and IT teams want the details?
docs.description: We maintain complete technical documentation: architecture, data flows, audit log, retention policies, processor contracts. Available on request, with no form to fill.
